point: The opening sentences give the topic.
開頭幾句就點出主題。
why: No trains will run on the Harbor Line and Replacement buses are boarding now: passengers travel a different way for now.
no trains will run on the Harbor Line 加上 Replacement buses are boarding now：旅客暫時要用別的方式搭車。

point: Only on paper means not real in practice.
only on paper 的意思是實際上不存在。
why: Some trains still appear on the departure board. Then Those trains exist only on paper: they are listed, but they will not run.
Some trains still appear on the departure board。接著 Those trains exist only on paper：班次有列出，但不會開。

point: The arrangement follows After that.
安排在 After that 之後。
why: The buses will run until 10:00 tonight. After that, please use the taxi stand. The railway will cover the fare: it pays for private transportation.
The buses will run until 10:00 tonight。After that, please use the taxi stand。The railway will cover the fare：鐵路公司負擔私人交通費。

gloss.ex: A signal failure delayed every train this morning.
Taxis wait in the forecourt of the station.
Please wait on the concourse until the platform is announced.
Your pass will remain valid until June.
The company will cover the fare for your trip.

point: The reason for a change follows But.
改變的原因在 But 之後。
why: Crews first said 9:00. But a tow company arrived early, so they now hope to open the bridge fully by 8:30. Help arriving early is the cause.
工作人員起初說 9:00。But a tow company arrived early, so they now hope to open the bridge fully by 8:30。救援提早到是原因。

point: The reason comes after But.
原因在 But 之後。
why: Drivers are turning onto Orchard Road to get around the bridge. But a repair there has closed a lane, so it is slow going as well. He mentions it as a warning.
駕駛 turning onto Orchard Road to get around the bridge。But 那裡的維修 has closed a lane，所以 slow going as well。他提到它是為了提醒。

point: Advice follows If you can.
建議在 If you can 之後。
why: If you can, leave your car at the Lakeside lot and take the Route 12 bus is his advice: public transportation for part of the trip. I'll update you again is his own plan.
If you can, leave your car at the Lakeside lot and take the Route 12 bus 是他的建議：部分路程改搭大眾運輸。I'll update you again 是他自己的安排。

gloss.ex: Traffic backed up for two miles on the highway.
The tow company arrived within ten minutes.
A broken water main flooded the street.
The road work made it slow going today.
I will update you again at noon.

point: The next sentence explains the quote.
下一句解釋這句話的原因。
why: You don't need to stay on the line is followed by Crews expect to restore service by 3:00. Callers need not wait because the problem is already being handled.
you don't need to stay on the line 後面接 Crews expect to restore service by 3:00。來電者不必等，因為問題已在處理。

point: A condition applies to one group of callers.
條件只適用於某一群來電者。
why: Key in your account number applies to callers who choose an option. Only callers on the phone number on your account can skip this step. Everyone else enters the number.
key in your account number 適用於選了選項的人。只有用 the phone number on your account 來電的人可以 skip this step。其他人要輸入號碼。

point: The alternative comes after If you'd rather not hold.
替代方案在 If you'd rather not hold 之後。
why: If you'd rather not hold, press 9. Then We'll then call you back within the hour. The offer is a later phone call from the company.
If you'd rather not hold, press 9。接著 We'll then call you back within the hour。這個提議是公司之後打電話聯絡。

gloss.ex: The outage lasted about three hours.
Technicians restored power to the building quickly.
Please key in your password to continue.
Your account number is on the invoice.
Please hold while I transfer your call.

point: The opening names the product or service.
開頭點出產品或服務。
why: Running out of room at home? is the need. We rent secure, indoor units by the month is the service: space to keep belongings.
Running out of room at home? 是需求。We rent secure, indoor units by the month 是服務：存放物品的空間。

point: Find the row from the audio, then the right column.
先從音檔找出那一列，再找對的欄。
why: Second-largest unit is Large. Sign up before the end of the month gives our special first-month rate, so read the First month column: $47.50.
Second-largest unit 是 Large。Sign up before the end of the month 適用 our special first-month rate，所以看 First month 欄：$47.50。

point: Read the quote as a meaning, not as words.
把引句當成意思來讀，不要照字面。
why: The ad says Running out of room at home? and offers units for belongings. Your garage can finally be a garage again means the space at home is free.
廣告先問 Running out of room at home?，並提供存放物品的單位。Your garage can finally be a garage again 的意思是家裡的空間空出來。

gloss.ex: This is the second-largest office in the building.
We cleared out the old files last week.
The supplier offered us a long-term contract.
Please sign up before Friday.
The indoor pool is open all year.

point: The reason follows because.
理由在 because 之後。
why: Please wear the badge all day, because you'll need it to get into lunch. Getting into lunch means being admitted to a meal.
Please wear the badge all day, because you'll need it to get into lunch。get into lunch 就是獲准進去用餐。

point: Sessions swap times, but rooms stay with sessions.
場次對調時間，教室跟著場次。
why: On the schedule, Room B is Using Data. The two afternoon sessions will switch times and each session keeps its original room, so the Room B session moves to 3:00.
表上 Room B 是 Using Data。The two afternoon sessions will switch times，each session keeps its original room，所以 Room B 的場次改到 3:00。

point: The condition for the drawing comes with the deadline.
抽獎的條件和期限一起說。
why: A short survey will be e-mailed at 4:00, but the deadline is by Friday. Everyone who completes it enters the drawing, so the task is answering the survey by the end of the week.
A short survey will be e-mailed at 4:00，但期限是 by Friday。Everyone who completes it 才能抽獎，所以要在週五前填完問卷。

gloss.ex: She is hosting the training session today.
Please wear your name badge at all times.
The two teams will switch times next week.
Please complete the survey before you leave.
Everyone who attends enters the prize drawing.

point: Guide and tour show who the listeners are.
guide 和 tour 顯示聽眾是誰。
why: I'll be your guide for this 45-minute tour. The speaker leads the visit, so the listeners are people taking it.
I'll be your guide for this 45-minute tour。說話者帶領參觀，所以聽眾是參加參觀的人。

point: The new plan follows Normally … but.
新安排在 Normally … but 之後。
why: Normally we begin with a tasting, but the room is booked, so we'll finish there instead. The tasting moves from the start to the end.
Normally we begin with a tasting, but 試喝室被訂走，so we'll finish there instead。試喝從開頭移到最後。

point: Before marks the first step.
Before 標出第一個步驟。
why: Before we set off, I need everyone's name on the visitor sheet. That is registering. Only once everyone's name is down do they head to the storage room.
Before we set off, I need everyone's name on the visitor sheet。這就是登記。once everyone's name is down 才 head to the storage room。

gloss.ex: The roastery smells wonderful in the morning.
The tasting begins at noon.
Wear earplugs because the machines are loud.
We will set off at nine.
Please write your name on the visitor sheet.
